staticBatchWorkingSet.problem: The prior grouping pass cloned all eligible scene geometry before any batch merged or released copies; the per-batch vertex limit did not bound simultaneous temporary copies.
staticBatchWorkingSet.change: Group source meshes first, transform copies for one bounded batch at a time, release copies in finally, clear processed source references, reuse each container inverse within a batch. Geometry remains unchanged.
staticBatchWorkingSet.verification: A clone/dispose regression test verifies live temporary-copy vertices never exceed 65536 and return to zero. Existing tests verify triangles, positions, collision metadata and full stair/gallery travel. Seven tests passed in optimizer/full model files; lint/typecheck/build passed.
staticBatchWorkingSet.limit: Total browser heap was not measured. The test bounds transformed temporary geometry copies, not all resident geometry. Overall startup is not proven faster; long batching pauses remain. Single browser samples are not controlled averages.

staticBatchPhaseScheduling.change: Named matrix-update, traversal, grouping, copy-transform and merge-attach phases. Copy-transform yields inside try/finally before merging. Cheap phases share an 8 ms task budget with an abort check at each boundary. Within copy-transform, check elapsed time every 16 meshes and yield when 8 ms has elapsed; a single operation can exceed the budget.
staticBatchPhaseScheduling.diagnostics: canvas.dataset.batchPhaseTimings reports count, totalMs and maxMs for each phase.
staticBatchPhaseScheduling.cancellation: Regression test aborts after copy-transform, verifies both temporary copies disposed, no merge-attach phase occurred, and original scene meshes/geometries remained untouched.
staticBatchPhaseScheduling.validation: Optimizer tests passed. Full model tests timed out under a heavily loaded renderer, then passed all four in 7.61 seconds after exiting the scene; no timeout changes. Typecheck, lint and build passed. After adding within-copy yields, optimizer tests passed 4/4 and final lint, typecheck and build passed.
staticBatchPhaseScheduling.limit: Initial concurrent measurements were incomplete and contaminated by high renderer load; no overall speedup established from those observations.

staticBufferCopy.validation: Five optimizer tests passed, including exact transformed positions/normals/UVs and procedural constructor count. Combined model test timed out under renderer load; isolated model tests passed 4/4 in 4.70 seconds. Lint, typecheck and build passed.

workerStaticBatching.implementation: Progressive static batching dispatches one bounded batch at a time to a module worker. Source buffers are structured-cloned, never transferred. Per-instance copies inside the worker prevent shared-template transforms from accumulating. Returned merged buffers are transferred back with computed bounds.
workerStaticBatching.compatibility: Synchronous path retained for unavailable/failed workers and morph/interleaved/instanced/half-float/non-default GPU attributes. Interactive owner coordinates and collision-anchor attachment remain on the main thread.
workerStaticBatching.lifecycle: Abort rejects the pending job and terminates worker; source geometry is removed only after a successful result. Worker created immediately before request listener registration.
workerStaticBatching.tests: 12 targeted optimizer/worker/full-model tests passed. Covers shared geometry buffers, non-uniform transforms, normalized color, index, bounds, worker failure and cancellation.
workerStaticBatching.limit: Single observation under changing host/test load. Worker CPU/wait is not included in zero-duration completion counters. Startup remains slow; this does not establish overall speedup or finish architectural reconstruction.
workerStaticBatching.finalValidation: Lint, typecheck, 12 targeted tests and production build passed. Full suite finished: 251 passed, 6 failed across 4 non-model files.
